## Behavior

What happened, and what should have happened?

## Reproduction

Use synthetic filenames and accounts. Include Cirrove version, Linux distribution,
and the smallest sequence that reproduces the issue.

## Evidence

Include sanitized errors or test output. No tokens, signed URLs, personal filenames,
real account/tenant identifiers or raw provider responses.
